description:
Filed by architect-0975cd3a 2026-08-22 while planning task-918145a5 (resource reconciliation), as the measured operator-side sibling that row deliberately does NOT absorb.

THE GAP: the scheduler quarantines a resource whenever release is uncertain — adapterFail with disposition UNKNOWN on the named row, or a non-fenceable acquiring sibling, yields state QUARANTINED (packages/scheduler/src/authority/lease-resource.ts:141-169; header: "Moe chooses safety over invented liveness and waits for a proven release"). The strict readiness reader treats QUARANTINED as NON-terminal, correctly, because grantSuccessorCapacity can still move it (release-terminal-evidence.ts probeMember). The ONLY reducer that clears QUARANTINED → RELEASED is grantSuccessorCapacity, which requires a proofRef (lease-resource.ts:225-241), surfaced as the GRANT arm of AttemptResourceReport (attempt-resource-authority-contracts.ts:100-106).

CONSEQUENCE: once any resource quarantines, the attempt can never become release-ready, so the resumable-release finalizer (task-48c79a29) will drain forever. That is SAFE (never a fabricated release) but STUCK, and nothing in production can clear it — applyAttemptResourceReport's GRANT arm has no ingress.

THE DESIGNED ROUTE, measured: apps/daemon/src/recovery/doctor-commands.ts:50-55 already maps "doctor.propose_resource_release" → "resource.confirm_released", but the doctor module only REPORTS/PROPOSES (header :11-24: appliesChange:false, confirmationRequired:true) — it names the vocabulary kind an operator would later carry out and never executes it. "resource.confirm_released" is frozen runtime vocabulary (packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:104) and is UNWIRED in the daemon: not in WiredCommandKind, no PAYLOAD_KEYS entry, no registry entry, no handler.

DELIVERABLE: an OPERATOR-authenticated resource.confirm_released ingress that carries a proof reference into applyAttemptResourceReport's GRANT arm, clearing QUARANTINED → RELEASED so a stuck attempt can reach release-readiness. The operator supplies a PROOF REFERENCE and identifies the attempt/resource; the operator may NOT assert terminality or a released state — grantSuccessorCapacity remains authoritative, and the strict readiness reader still derives set-terminality by probing.

SIBLING/SCOPE: task-918145a5 wires the ADAPTER axis (resource.reconcile, work.write, CONFIRM/FAIL reports from the attempt itself per design 312's drain-admitted list). This row wires the OPERATOR axis (resource.confirm_released, operator principal, GRANT). NOT in scope: the adapter ingress (918145a5), the release finalizer (48c79a29), doctor's proposal shape. CONSUMERS: task-48c79a29 (finalizer) and transitively task-e62e3828.
